questions.q: At 7:55 A.M., what does Mr. Ruiz most likely mean when he writes, "The night shift supervisor says yes"?

The supervisor will join the training session.
The maintenance crew worked late last night.
The trainees have already been approved for the course.
questions.explain:
유형: PART 7 · 의도 파악

Did someone use it overnight?" → says yes = 밤사이 누가 썼다. 충전한 뒤에 썼으니 배터리가 나갔다. → 보기 "was operated after it was charged" (use it overnight = was operated, charged yesterday afternoon = after it was charged)

questions.q: What is the purpose of the notice?
options: To announce an increase in water rates
To inform residents about upcoming equipment work
To ask residents to read their own meters
To explain how to open a new service account
questions.explain:
유형: PART 7 · 주제·목적
정답 (B) To inform residents about upcoming equipment work
해석: 안내문의 목적은 무엇인가?
정답 근거: 정답 포인트 — 목적은 첫 문장에 있다. "technicians will replace the water meters at all homes" → 기술자가 계량기를 교체한다. → 보기 "inform residents about upcoming equipment work" (replace the water meters = equipment work, June 8~19 = upcoming)
오답 분석: (A) 요금 인상 얘기는 없다. 오히려 계량기는 무료다. / (C) 새 계량기가 자동으로 수치를 보낸다고 했다. 주민이 직접 읽으라는 말이 아니다. / (D) 새 계정 개설 방법은 나오지 않는다.

questions.q: What is NOT mentioned about the meter replacement?
options: It will briefly interrupt the water supply.
Residents will be notified before it takes place.
Residents must be at home while it is done.
Residents will not have to pay for it.
questions.explain:

정답 (C) Residents must be at home while it is done.
해석: 계량기 교체에 대해 언급되지 않은 것은?
정답 근거: 정답 포인트 — NOT 문제는 보기를 하나씩 지문과 맞춰 지운다. (A) "your water service will be turned off during that time"(30분) = briefly interrupt. (B) "receive a card ... at least two days before" = notified before. (D) "There is no charge" = not have to pay. 주민이 집에 있어야 한다는 말은 어디에도 없다. → (C)
오답 분석: (A) 30분 동안 물이 끊긴다고 했다. 언급됨. / (B) 이틀 전에 카드가 온다고 했다. 언급됨. / (D) no charge = 무료. 언급됨.

questions.explain:

해석: 오후 1시 23분에 보스버그 씨가 "피아노가 일반 문으로는 안 들어가요"라고 쓴 것은 무슨 의미이겠는가?

Questions 161-163 refer to the following article.

Brightwell Tea Buys Former Dairy Plant

(Corrin Falls, April 28) — Brightwell Tea, the maker of bottled iced teas sold
in more than 900 stores across the region, has purchased the former Hadley
Dairy plant on Route 9. The company plans to begin production there in the
fall.

Brightwell currently produces all of its drinks at a small facility in
downtown Corrin Falls. According to company president Nadia Ferrante, demand
has grown so quickly over the past two years that the downtown site can no
longer keep up. "We have been running three shifts a day, and we still can't
fill every order," she said.

The Route 9 plant is four times the size of the current facility. Brightwell
will spend about $6 million on new bottling equipment and expects to hire 45
additional workers. The downtown facility will be converted into a test
kitchen and visitor center.

Local officials welcomed the news. The Hadley plant has stood empty since the
dairy relocated to Ohio three years ago.

From: Gwen Albright, Human Resources Director
Date: February 3
